proof_body:
by
  intro ω h n
  have h3 : ω ^ 3 = 1 := by linear_combination (ω - 1) * h
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ω ^ (3 * k) = 1 := fun k => by rw [pow_mul, h3, one_pow]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have e : ω ^ (2 * (3 * k)) = (ω ^ (3 * k)) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e, hk]
    norm_num
  · intro hn
    have hmod : n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
    have hdiv : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.div_add_mod n 3).symm
    rcases hmod with hm | hm
    · rw [hm] at hdiv
      have e1 : ω ^ n = ω := by rw [hdiv, pow_add, hk]; simp
      have e2 : ω ^ (2 * n) = ω ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm, pow_mul, e1]
      rw [e1, e2]
      linear_combination h
    · rw [hm] at hdiv
      have e1 : ω ^ n = ω ^ 2 := by rw [hdiv, pow_add, hk]; simp
      have e2 : ω ^ (2 * n) = ω := by
        rw [mul_comm, pow_mul, e1]
        linear_combination ω * h3
      rw [e1, e2]
      linear_combination h
